core_operator: LOCAL_EXCITATION -> TRANSDUCE -> THRESHOLD -> LOCALIZE -> POINT -> VERIFY_SOURCE

possible_event_locations.in_detector: local detector event produces a localized response without a corresponding external point source
possible_event_locations.post_detector: processing/interpretation produces or reshapes the localized percept/detection

cross_detector_homology.human_retina: local physical or neural excitation -> transduction -> threshold crossing -> localized visual signal -> perceived point
cross_detector_homology.photographic_plate: photon/particle/emulsion event -> grain response -> threshold -> localized mark -> star-like point
cross_detector_homology.ccd_cmos: photon/particle/sensor event -> charge -> threshold/detection -> pixel/PSF -> point detection
cross_detector_homology.firewall: RETINA != PHOTOGRAPHIC_PLATE != CCD; shared architecture does not imply identical causes or identical physical mechanisms.

representation_contract.target_invariant_I: causal origin of a localized point-like detection
representation_contract.representation_R: detector-output event represented as a localized point plus detector/state metadata
must_preserve: spatial localization relative to detector/reference frame
whether the event repeats across independent detectors/exposures
raw evidence sufficient to distinguish detector-local from externally coherent events
representation_contract.metric: cross-witness localization/recurrence consistency plus detector-local artifact controls
representation_contract.positive_control: known external point source must recur coherently in world coordinates across appropriate independent observations
representation_contract.negative_control: known detector-local artifacts may create point-like outputs without world-coordinate recurrence
representation_contract.falsifier: If the claimed shared machine disappears after removing surface vocabulary and cannot be expressed as local excitation -> transduction -> threshold -> localization, classify the relation as linguistic analogy only.
representation_contract.unknown_rule: EXTERNAL/DETECTOR_LOCAL/POST_PROCESSING remains OPEN unless evidence discriminates among them.

space_lock_vs_detector_lock.world_locked: A real external source should remain consistent in an external/world reference frame after accounting for observer/detector motion and acquisition geometry.
space_lock_vs_detector_lock.detector_or_field_locked: A detector-local or retinal-field event may remain tied to detector coordinates or the perceptual field instead of an external world coordinate.

palomar_bridge.allowed_claim: Palomar photographic plates, human visual detectors, and CCD/CMOS sensors can all generate the same output symbol POINT through multiple causal routes.
palomar_bridge.forbidden_claim: A human punctate visual event is therefore the same physical phenomenon as any particular Palomar transient.

hidden_machine_test.remaining_architecture: localized excitation -> transduction -> threshold -> spatial localization -> point output -> source discrimination

medical_firewall.scope: This artifact is a detector/epistemic model, not a diagnosis of any individual symptom.
medical_firewall.urgent_change_rule: Sudden increase in flashes or floaters, a new shadow/curtain, or loss of vision warrants prompt professional eye evaluation; this safety rule is independent of the R3 analogy.

next_gate.name: R3-M01 MULTI-DETECTOR CAUSAL DISCRIMINATION TEST
requirements: freeze world-coordinate versus detector-coordinate predictions before inspecting new candidate events
separate detector-local artifact models from external-source models
do not infer source identity from point morphology alone

canonical_seal: THE POINT IS AN OUTPUT SYMBOL, NOT A SOURCE LABEL. RETINA, PLATE, AND CCD CAN SHARE A DETECTOR MACHINE WITHOUT SHARING A CAUSE. LOCALIZE THE EVENT, PRESERVE THE REFERENCE FRAME, AND VERIFY THE SOURCE.
